# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 8 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Greek MS | **Section:** Aseneth's Confession and Prayer for Mercy

---

**8:1** 'I am your handmaid, Lord, the daughter of Pentephres the great priest — but I was proud and arrogant, boasting in my wealth and luxury.'

**8:2** 'I trusted in my beauty and was conceited, boasting before all men, saying: "Who is there like me?" And now I am humbled, brought low, desolate and afflicted.'

**8:3** 'Have mercy on me, Lord — orphan and desolate, for my father and mother have denied me, saying: "Aseneth is not our daughter," because I destroyed their gods.'

**8:4** 'Everyone hates me, and even Pharaoh's son hates me because I refused him and despised him.'

**8:5** 'But I implore you, Lord, for you alone are gracious and tenderhearted and gentle. Save me before I am seized by a wicked man.'

**8:6** 'Rescue me, Lord, before evil men enslave me. Rescue me, Lord, as a father rescues a little child, for you are the great and mighty Father and your compassion is great.'

**8:7** 'A father loves his own child as his own soul, and a mother tends her infant with deep care. But you, Lord, are more compassionate than any father or mother.'

**8:8** 'Have mercy on me, Lord. Look upon my affliction and my abasement, and have pity on me according to the greatness of your mercy.'

**8:9** 'For you, Lord, are sweet and good and gentle, more patient and more merciful than all other gods.'

**8:10** 'For all the gods of Egypt are old and ugly and dead — gods of wood and stone.'

**8:11** 'But you, Lord, are the living God, your kingdom is eternal, your life will not pass away, and your years will never end.'

**8:12** 'Have pity on me, Lord, for I am afflicted and desolate — in you alone, Lord, do I take refuge.'

---
*SOPHIA: consensus rendering. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
